newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via over-the-weekend system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via over-the-weekend system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system through over-the-weekend system repurchase agreements Friday, a New York Fed spokeswoman said.
The operation was expected given the high federal funds rate. Funds had risen to 6 percent, before easing to 5-3/4 percent at the time of the Fed's action.
The Fed entered the market an hour ahead of its usual 1130 EST/1630 GMT intervention period, which was also anticipated because of the early bond market close this session.
